note: A McCreary County park with paved RV sites, primitive tent sites, a playground, picnic shelter and community building. The county posts no rates or booking page; the figure held comes from a camper's 2024 stay. --Claude
summary: Kept. County-run park confirmed (KY auditor's FY2025 county audit names 'collections at Sandhill Park'; Sandhill's phone is the county park manager's line). Electric/water sites, showers and dump confirmed on the county tourism listing. Still no posted rate: $25 from an RV Life review of an Oct 2024 stay is the newest figure (fees left as stored). Google 4.6/38. Not waterfront; pin on the park.
flags: Web presence is thin: no county page for the campground itself; the McCreary County Tourist Commission listing (stored website) and Kentucky Tourism listing are the official presence; the Facebook page is an unofficial auto-generated one (it shows 606-376-9333, not used). The county's FY2025 audit confirms the county collects camping fees at Sandhill Park, so it is operating.

Fees unchanged: no operator rate anywhere; the $25 a night from an RV Life review (stay Oct 2024) remains the only dated figure (an earlier review paid $22 in Jul 2022). A phone call to 606-376-7275 would settle it.
Site count conflict: stored 80 (from a reviewer's '80 blacktop sites'); RV Life's listing says 32. Left as stored, unverified.
Electric amperage unknown (RV Life lists 30/20/15 amp, aggregator only); electric not written.
Esri imagery shows an event-day crowd (cars and RVs filling the loops); one reviewer says 'usually only a handful of campers'. County park, so the private long-stay tests do not apply.
Pin OK (36.76483,-84.41364 on the park road between the loops). Phone OK. Not waterfront confirmed (no water near the pads).
